identificationModule.briefTitle: SHR-1316 in Combination With Chemotherapy in Patients With Esophageal Squamous Cell Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: SHR-1316, a Novel Anti-PD-L1 Antibody, in Combination With Irinotecan Liposome and Fluorouracil in Patients With Esophageal Squamous Cell Cancer: a Phase II Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the progression-free survival (PFS) of Chemotherapy combined with SHR-1316 in patients with advanced esophageal squamous cell cancer.
